definition: server_ms is the Server-Timing presign;dur value of each 200 response: the time from the start of the route handler to the response, rate limit and lookup included, network and platform routing not included. wall_ms is the round trip measured by the probe, network included. cold_start_server_ms and cold_start_wall_ms are from the first 200 of the run (cold check cache and instance warmup on the probe's seller URL). p50 and p99 are nearest-rank over the remaining 199 responses with status 200 (all but the first), counted in warmup_samples. The probe sends the calls one after another with the same 402 to seller_url, so later calls can hit the 60-second check cache: server_ms is the speed of checking the same seller again, not of a first check. target_met judges server_ms of this same-seller series only: true when warmup_samples is 20 or more and server_ms.p99 is at or under target_p99_server_ms (300). It does not judge cold_start_server_ms or distinct_sellers. This file counts the calls of this probe run only, not other callers.
distinct_sellers_definition: distinct_sellers is a separate run for the first check of a seller: the probe picks sellers that delivered in the last 30 days from GET /api/v1/delivery/sellers.json?min_delivered=1 (one GET URL per host, most deliveries first, the same-seller probe's host left out), fetches each seller's real 402 without paying, and sends it to presign once. No URL is sent twice. URLs that did not answer 402 are skipped and counted, not sent. server_ms and wall_ms are defined as above; p50 and p99 are nearest-rank over the responses with status 200 of that run, and max is the slowest. cache_path counts the Server-Timing cache desc of those responses (none when the desc was missing): direct and coalesced read the seller in the request; fresh is a value the 60-second check cache returned, which on a first check is either the read made in this request (nothing was cached) or a value another caller left in the last 60 seconds; prefetch is a value read ahead in the background.
